text: Acme API authentication uses a Bearer access token. Access tokens expire after 30 minutes.
Acme Standard rate limits permit 120 requests per minute. Excess requests receive HTTP 429.
Acme exports are retained for 14 days. The maximum export size is 50 megabytes.
Acme refunds are available within 14 days of purchase. Refunds require a support ticket.
Acme critical incidents are escalated to the on-call engineer. Support is available Monday through Friday.
Acme support contact email is helpdesk@example.com. The synthetic callback phone is 202-555-0147.
Acme recovery canary is TEST-ONLY-ACME-CANARY. This is synthetic tenant-private fixture data.
Beta API authentication uses a signed client certificate. Client certificates expire after 90 days.
Beta Business rate limits permit 600 requests per minute. Excess requests receive HTTP 429.
Beta exports are retained for 30 days. The maximum export size is 200 megabytes.
Beta refunds are available within 7 days of purchase. Refunds require the billing reference.
Beta critical incidents are escalated to the reliability lead. Support is available every day.
Beta support contact email is team@example.org. The synthetic callback phone is 202-555-0198.
Beta recovery canary is TEST-ONLY-BETA-CANARY. This is synthetic tenant-private fixture data.
